_comment: Ceilings (differing-pixel ratio) for frames where the C++ engine rendering the frozen scene document (scenes/<id>.json) differs from the reference. A LIST OF DEBTS: a frame may not get worse, and its entry goes when it matches. Written by scripts/native-golden.mjs --update-baseline; review the diff.

_why.blend-luminosity#0: WARP only (CI runner, no GPU): 0.56 % of pixels a step off in the Luminosity blend; the RTX 4060 run matches the reference exactly.
_why.effect-apply-color-lut-gpu#0: 0.70 % at <= 1/255 steps: the .cube lattice sampled in float on the GPU vs the WebGL2 reference's 8-bit path; under the product tolerance, over this scene's tighter one.
_why.effect-posterize#0: Path raster AA amplified by posterize: the engine draws on Skia's CPU raster, the reference on Chromium's GPU canvas (native-raster-baseline.json, same debt).
_why.fill-opacity-zero-inner-shadow#0: The same WebGPU-vs-WebGL2 reference debt the TS WebGPU backend carries (webgpu-baseline.json 3.288 %); the frame is structurally equal to the TS FrameScene. Raised 3.392 → 3.597 % by the I5 output dither (2026-10-10: every changed value is exactly 1/255 against the pre-dither render).
_why.light-spot#0: Same debt as webgpu-baseline.json (1.233 %): spot falloff rounding, WebGPU vs the WebGL2-blessed reference.
_why.mask-feather#0: Feather blur edge, 0.84 %: Skia's blur vs the WebGL2 reference (was 6.2 % before the Chromium-GPU blur algorithm, D2w effects).
_why.model-maps#0: Same debt as webgpu-baseline.json (9.905 %): PBR maps shaded on WebGPU vs the WebGL2 reference; the base-colour texture now renders (was 24 %: textured leaves needed a session src). Raised 9.877 → 10.628 % by the I5 output dither (2026-10-10: every changed value is exactly 1/255 against the pre-dither render).
_why.svg-embedded-raster#0: Same debt as webgpu-baseline.json (19.156 %): Chromium upscales the SVG's 2x2 embedded bitmap with its low-quality filter in the WebGL2 reference; the engine filters it bilinearly. WARP filters the same upscale a little differently: 19.87 % there vs under 19.3 % on the GPU.
_why.three-d-dof-visible#0: Same debt as webgpu-baseline.json (5.243 %); the C++ FrameScene is structurally equal to the TS one (premation-scene against the TS .pfs).
_why.video-decoded-frame#13: E1 decode: ffmpeg YUV->RGB (chroma siting / matrix rounding) vs Chromium's WebCodecs decode of the same H.264 frame.
_why.video-decoded-frame#5: E1 decode: ffmpeg YUV->RGB (chroma siting / matrix rounding) vs Chromium's WebCodecs decode of the same H.264 frame.
